response.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS diff FROM budget WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT AVG(diff) AS base FROM d) SELECT d.event_status, AVG(d.diff) AS avg_diff, AVG(d.diff) - b.base AS diff_from_baseline FROM d CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.event_status, b.base

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the row-level average of amount - spent over all budget rows whose difference is non-null. A row with a missing amount or spent has no difference to average, so it is left out of the baseline as well as the status averages.
A NULL event_status, if any, would be reported as its own group.
